description: Records the result of the chart-verification pass over the Brave-sourced signs: 54 whose artwork was compared against the official DoT chart and MATCHES. Until now every one of these carried alignment='not_in_chart' and in_official_chart=false, which was not a finding but an artefact — the ingest that approved them used a Brave web search and never opened the chart, so the fields recorded the absence of a check rather than the absence of the sign. The 13 that failed the same comparison are withdrawn in withdraw-blank-plates-2026-08-03.json; three that do not exist at all were withdrawn earlier the same day.

ops.why: Chart-verified 2026-08-03. The sign's own plate was located on the official DoT chart by its caption's bounding box, cropped, and rendered side by side with public/signs/<code>.svg for visual comparison. Artwork matches. Previously the row read alignment='not_in_chart' and in_official_chart=false even though the code IS on the chart — those fields were written by the Brave-search ingest, which never actually opened the chart, so they recorded 'I did not look' as 'it is not there'.
